answer_1.quote: Argumentative essay generation (AEG) is a task designed to generate a persuasive argumentative text ... We evaluate our model on the ArgEssay dataset ...

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation. Based on the systems theory of argumentation, we evaluate the persuasive of argumentative essay from the following five aspects: Relevance, Validity of the Reasoning, Credibility of Evidence, Language and Rhetoric and Overall Persuasiveness ... BLEU can be insufficient ...
automatic_metrics: GPT-4 based evaluation scores (Relevance, Validity of Reasoning, Credibility of Evidence, Language and Rhetoric, Overall Persuasiveness)

answer_3.quote: We propose a GPT-4-based AEG evaluation approach. The model is prompted to give a detailed explanation before the final prediction of score.

answer_4.quote: We employed three skilled English speakers with NLP background to perform manual evaluation of the generated results. We set up two evaluation tasks: scoring the generated text ... and compare the results with baselines.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score generated essays on five aspects (Relevance, Validity of Reasoning, Credibility of Evidence, Language and Rhetoric, Overall Persuasiveness) using the same criteria as the GPT‑4 prompts.
